title: fix-2158026 → ubuntu/devel
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 30c3b0c..f193178 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,12 @@
+openssl (4.0.1-1ubuntu2) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * Add Depends on libjitterentropy3-dev, zlib1g-dev, and libzstd-dev.
+    libcrypto.pc declares these as static private dependencies
+    (Libs.private) but libssl-dev did not pull them in, breaking static
+    linking against libcrypto. (LP: #2158026)
+
+ -- Ravi Kant Sharma <ravi.kant.sharma@canonical.com>  Mon, 03 Aug 2026 16:49:15 +0200
+
 openssl (4.0.1-1ubuntu1) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   [ Ravi Kant Sharma ]
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index 3a0ec31..bb0b890 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -88,7 +88,11 @@ Section: libdevel
 Architecture: any
 Multi-Arch: same
 Suggests: libssl-doc
-Depends: libssl4 (= ${binary:Version}), ${misc:Depends}
+Depends: libssl4 (= ${binary:Version}),
+         libjitterentropy3-dev,
+         zlib1g-dev,
+         libzstd-dev,
+         ${misc:Depends}
